_why: WHICH REGISTER PERSON EACH NARRATIVE PAGE IS ABOUT, declared rather than matched.
This archive holds THREE people with Kurt in the name: 9500001 Kurt Israel
Luwinski (b. 11 May 1912, d. 15 December 1968), 9500040 Kurt Luwinski (d. 1995,
no birth recorded) and 9500022 Michael, Kurt Leibholz (1951-2005). A match on
the page's filename resolves kurt.astro to the wrong man, and the first draft of
this work did exactly that — it drew Leo Luwinski and Martha Fuhl as Kurt
Israel's parents, who are 9500040's. His are Jacob Leibholz and Auguste.
kurt.astro also contains the string 9500005, which is a PHOTOGRAPH number and not
a person: 9500005 is Johannes Antonie Oelofse de Witt, who married Ivone after
Kurt. So reading an id out of the page's text is no safer than reading its name.
LEONARD IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT FROM THIS FILE. He has a page and no register row,
because worklist row 1 is open and blocked: «Confirm Leonard Aubrey Robert Wear as
Derrick's biological father from a document, not an inference». He is the man the
DNA points at. A chart joining him to anybody would publish the inference this
archive is refusing to publish, so his page states the absence instead.

derrick.why: Lynn Derrick Luwinski. Living, named and nothing more — the register carries no dates for him and the chart therefore shows none.

kurt.why: Kurt Israel Luwinski, by the page's own title. NOT 9500040, a different Kurt Luwinski with different parents.

ivone.why: Ivone / Mota «Yvonne» Figueiredo, by the page's own title.
